title: 云原生与 AI 基础设施：从实践学习到生产级 Agentic 系统
english: Recent updates point to a converging cloud-native and AI infrastructure agenda. A CNCF LFX mentorship account describes hands-on work deploying OpenTelemetry Collectors on AWS EC2 and debugging inter-machine networking. CNCF also announced that KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America will add an AI Inference + Agentic track, alongside sessions on production AI, platform engineering, and cloud native security. OpenAI reported lessons from building an AI-native finance function, including automated forecasting, stronger controls, and AI ROI. Its updates also describe traceable finance outputs and a cybersecurity-specific model for authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation, and security testing.
chinese: 这组信息显示，云原生能力正从教程式学习转向真实环境中的部署、可观测性与网络排障；同时，AI 推理、Agentic 系统、平台工程和安全正在成为同一基础设施议题的一部分。AI 在财务场景中的应用强调自动化预测、控制能力、ROI，以及可编辑、可追溯的交付物。安全侧则出现面向授权漏洞研究、利用验证和安全测试的专用模型方向。
why_it_matters: 对资深运维开发而言，重点不只是运行 Kubernetes 或接入模型，而是构建可观测、可调试、可治理的生产系统：管理 OpenTelemetry Collector 等遥测组件，处理跨机器网络问题，并为 AI 推理与 Agent 工作流建立控制、追溯和安全测试机制。这也对应平台工程、AIOps 与 Agent Infra 的能力交集。
interview_expression: I focus on operating AI-enabled platforms as production systems, with observability, traceability, and security controls built into the workflow. My cloud-native experience helps me connect telemetry, networking, and platform engineering requirements to AI inference and agent workloads.

vocabulary.meaning: 可观测性；通过遥测数据理解系统运行状态的能力。
vocabulary.example: Observability helps engineers debug networking problems between machines.

vocabulary.meaning: 可追溯的；能够追踪输出、过程或来源。
vocabulary.example: The workflow produces editable and traceable finance outputs.

vocabulary.meaning: 利用验证；在授权范围内验证漏洞利用是否可行的安全测试活动。
vocabulary.example: The model is available for authorized exploit validation and security testing.
